WOD20HM.KeybindPlaceHint: Place a health/willpower monitor tile on the scene (Tiles layer).
WOD20HM.SettingsMenuHint: Use this if the Tiles toolbar button or keybinding is hard to find. Click below, then click the scene to place a monitor tile.
WOD20HM.PlacementHint: Tiles layer: click the scene to place a health monitor tile. Press Esc or pick another tool to cancel.
WOD20HM.ReadyHint: WoD Health Monitor: Game Settings → Module Settings → WoD20 Health Monitor (cog) → Place Health Monitor. Or Tiles layer → heart icon. Keybind: Ctrl+Shift+P. Chat: /phm
WOD20HM.ConfigBlurb: Choose a character or NPC whose health and willpower this tile should mirror. Health: empty, / (bashing), X (lethal), * (aggravated). Willpower: one row with a box per maximum willpower; X marks temporary willpower (WoD5e uses the same damage-style track as health).
WOD20HM.ErrNoCanvas: Canvas is not ready; open a scene first.
WOD20HM.ErrNoPermission: You do not have permission to modify this scene’s tiles.
WOD20HM.ErrTextureUpload: Could not save health tile image to world data. Ensure you are GM and have upload permission.
